process_map.name: Plan
process_map.description: Annual Business Plan, Sales Strategy, monthly targets & KPIs set by role and region (100% sales target, >=90% collection baseline)

process_map.name: Generate
process_map.description: Market research reports; lead generation via field visits, digital campaigns, references, and inter-departmental referral program

process_map.name: Acquire & Onboard
process_map.description: Lead engagement (site visit, volume forecast) -> KYC + bank guarantee -> negotiation -> signed agreement -> customer code in IBOS/CRM

process_map.name: Approve
process_map.description: Price/discount + credit days/limit approval via delegation matrix; ERP system setup with price, credit days, limit, alerts

process_map.name: Order-to-Cash (B2B & B2C)
process_map.description: IBOS order booking (Order ID; cutoff 3h pre-batch) -> schedule (TM/pump/route) -> batch + QC (slump, cubes) -> dispatch 'In Transit' -> 'Delivered' + DO -> invoice -> collection

process_map.name: After-Sales & Retention
process_map.description: Follow-up call <=24h -> complaints (ack <=1h, resolve by class) -> service recovery -> KAM (top 20%, quarterly reviews) -> win-back dormant >90d

process_map.name: Collection & Bad Debt
process_map.description: 0-30d Sales -> 31-60d Accounts -> 61d+ Recovery Cell/Legal -> credit note / partial settlement / write-off (CFO+Audit+CEO sign-off)

process_map.name: Incentives
process_map.description: Inner referral slabs, sales achievement incentives (100% sales + >=90% collection), external referral incentives (post-paid/pre-paid/non-cash)

process_map.name: Govern & Report
process_map.description: Weekly meetings, IBOS sales report, weekly aging review, quarterly credit limit review, monthly/quarterly pricing review, audit

onboarding_gates: No credit customer activated without documented approval + bank guarantee/security
No sale without: application form, verified bank guarantee (if applicable), signed agreement, approved IBOS/CRM customer code
KYC documents: trade license, TIN, bank statement, solvency certificate, NID, references
Customer records digitized and retained >=3 years for audit
credit_rules: New customers: 0-45 days; existing customers: up to 60 days; exceptions up to 60 days (large projects/reputed corporates)
Overdue beyond 60 days triggers automatic credit hold
Credit limits reviewed every 3 months based on payment history
All credit backed by Trade License, TIN, BIN, PO/Work Order
order_to_cash_rules: All orders must be booked in IBOS; verbal/manual orders invalid
Same-day delivery cutoff: at least 3 hours before batching
Only confirmed, IBOS-approved orders can be batched
No unauthorized edits/deletions/offline entries; changes timestamped
Exceptions require Plant Manager or Sales Head approval and logged as 'exception entry'
Invoice generated only after order marked 'Delivered'
complaint_and_service_recovery: Resolve: Class A quality 48-72h, Class B delivery/pump 24h, Class C billing 48h, Class D behavior 72h
Escalate to Sales Head if TAT missed; to CEO if unresolved after 3 days
Compensation (replacement, pump refund, credit note, goodwill gift) requires Sales Head/CEO approval
retention_rules: Follow-up call within 24 hours of delivery
Customers inactive >90 days flagged for re-engagement
Top 20% of customers by revenue = Strategic Accounts (KAM, quarterly business reviews)
Quarterly customer satisfaction surveys; monthly service log trend review

inner_referral: Eligible: full-time Akij Resource employees outside ARMCL Sales/BD/Pricing; excludes temp/contract/intern
First valid submitter wins; duplicates/rejected if already in pipeline; validation within 48 working hours
No prorated/partial payouts; paid only after full delivery + full payment; TDS deducted
sales_achievement: Mandatory 100% sales target; minimum qualifying collection 90%
Monthly slab by designation (100% collection / 90-99%): AGM-GM 14,000/12,000 | Manager-Sr.Mgr 13,000/12,000 | Dy.Mgr 12,000/9,000 | Asst.Mgr 11,000/8,500 | Officer 8,000/6,000
Bonus: +2,000 if collection >110%; 10,000 quarterly consistency (3 consecutive months); 5,000 monthly best performer per region
Disqualified if collection delayed beyond credit terms, dues unresolved >60 days, or documentation incomplete
external_referral: All incentives pre-approved by Sales Head and documented
Post-paid: commission per CFT (BDT 1-4/CFT) or fixed lump sum, only after full payment received
Pre-paid: written justification + customer details before disbursement
Non-cash gifts: against budgeted allocation, quarterly approved item list, store challan + recipient signature/photo
Records retained >=3 years; monthly report to CEO/CFO; annual audit

bad_debt_rules: Follow-up ladder: 0-30d Sales -> 31-60d Accounts -> 61d+ Recovery Cell, reported as potential bad debt in MIS
Sales incentives held or reversed for amounts pending beyond 60 days
Adjustments only post-dispute-resolution, documented, approved by Head of Sales + Head of Accounts, validated by Internal Audit
Write-off sign-off: CFO + Audit + CEO (if above threshold)
TDS/AIT delay: 3 reminders, ledger adjusted after 90 days with tax implications noted
business_rules.pricing_confidentiality: Standard and customer-specific prices are confidential; external disclosure results in disciplinary action
